summary: Iteration 5 verification: shop expanded to 15 products with 3 signature guitars (lightning-v $399 with gallery[4]+sheet; galaxy-v $299 with gallery[4]+sheet; storm-v $299 with gallery[4]+sheet). Backend: 16/16 pytest passing (products list, product detail, 404, 11 static images, checkout stores origin+correct amount 328.98=299+2*14.99, payments/status returns pending, send_receipt sets receipt_sent+buyer_email and is idempotent on second call). Frontend: /shop renders 15 cards; category filters signature-guitars/amps/strings/pedals present; ProductDetail for lightning-v shows name, $399.00, 4 thumbs, thumb-2 swaps main image to lightning-v-pickups.jpg, main-image opens lightbox at '3 / 4', next→'4 / 4', ArrowLeft→'3 / 4', Escape closes; spec sheet has Body row; add-to-cart works and opens drawer; related shows related-galaxy-v & related-storm-v. /shop/groovwah has no gallery and no spec-sheet as expected. /shop/doesnotexist redirects to /shop. AppDetail lightbox: groovsesh screen-open→'1 / 3', gallery-2→'3 / 3'; groovbox has 2 gallery buttons, landscape-open→'2 / 2'; groovtrackz has no gallery, single-screen lightbox opens with no counter (correct). Home guitar stage shows 3 guitars with correct prices; stage-guitar-link-storm-v→/shop/storm-v; stage-add-to-cart-galaxy-v opens the cart drawer (confirmed via screenshot).

console_warnings.warning: React: 'Encountered two children with the same key /jamnow/groovbox-home.jpg' — in AppDetail.jsx the `screens` array uses `g.src` as React key; for groovbox, `app.artwork` and `app.landscape.src` both point to /jamnow/groovbox-home.jpg, producing duplicate keys. Fix: use index-based key like `${i}-${g.src}` or ensure landscape uses a distinct src.
2× generic 'Failed to load resource: 404' console errors observed on some navigations (source not surfaced by console message). Non-blocking.

action_items: AppDetail.jsx: dedupe React key on the `screens` array (use `${i}-${g.src}` or filter landscape when it equals artwork) — groovbox emits duplicate-key warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.send_receipt is correctly idempotent (guarded by receipt_sent) and stores buyer_email; verified end-to-end.
Checkout persists origin (rstripped) and amount matches sum(price*qty); confirmed via direct Mongo inspection.
Lightbox correctly handles Escape / Arrow keys / next-prev and shows counter only when count>1 (groovtrackz single screen has no counter as spec requires).
ProductDetail hides gallery when only one image and hides spec-sheet when product has no `sheet` (groovwah verified).
server.py is now 763 lines — consider splitting into routers/{auth,shop,payments,contact,account}.py to stay <700 lines per module.
AppDetail duplicate-key: `screens.map((g,i) => <button key={g.src} ...>)` breaks when artwork.src == landscape.src (groovbox case).
